proof.text: Apply [e1-prime-coefficient-curve-assertions] to k, the reduced proper curve f, the prime r and the constructible R-module sheaf F. This gives hA : IsCurve.Assertions R f F, with R = ULift(F_r). No field extension or degree is fixed by this assertion package.

Use the C7 field of [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions], namely Assertions.bijective_cohomologyMap_of_isProper [def-weil-pbc-C7], with the existing IsProper f instance, the given algebraically closed field k′, the given pullback square h and the arbitrary degree q. Its conclusion is definitionally Function.Bijective of Etale.cohomologyMap on the underlying abelian sheaf obtained by sheafCompose with forget₂. This is exactly the displayed conclusion; no change of coefficient category or comparison isomorphism is inserted.

title: Algebraically closed extension for reduced curves with constructible prime coefficients
statement: Let k and k' be algebraically closed fields [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Let f : C → Spec k be a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] proper curve [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], and let C' → C be the projection in any cartesian square over Spec k' → Spec k [def-pc-base-change]. For any prime r and constructible sheaf F of ULift(F_r)-modules on C_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf], the pullback map on the cohomology of its underlying abelian sheaf [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] is bijective in every natural-number degree.

lean.statement: theorem algebraicallyClosedCohomologyInvariant {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {C C' : Scheme.{u}} (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve f] [IsProper f] [IsReduced C] (k' : Type u) [Field k'] [IsAlgClosed k'] {ι : Spec (.of k') ⟶ Spec (.of k)} {f' : C' ⟶ Spec (.of k')} {ι' : C' ⟶ C} (h : IsPullback ι' f' f ι) {r : ℕ} [Fact r.Prime] (F : Sheaf C.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r)))) [Scheme.IsConstructibleSheaf F] (q : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (Etale.cohomologyMap ι' ((sheafCompose _ (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod r))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj F) q)
